build_PatchEmbed: build a PatchEmbed module to convert image tensors into patch embeddings with configurable kernel size and stride
build_PatchMerging: build a PatchMerging layer to downsample patch feature maps using nn.Unfold for Swin Transformer compatibility
build_MultiheadAttention: build a MultiheadAttention wrapper around torch.nn.MultiheadAttention with identity connection and positional encoding support
build_FFN: build a FeedForwardNetwork with configurable fully-connected layers, activation, dropout, and optional identity connection
build_BaseTransformerLayer: build a BaseTransformerLayer with customizable operation order supporting prenorm, self-attention, cross-attention, and FFN
